description: This file defines the VoiceWakeRuntime actor responsible for managing voice wake commands, speech recognition, and related audio processing. It handles starting/stopping recognition sessions, processing audio input, recognizing wake words and commands, managing recognition states, and coordinating user interface overlays and feedback. The code facilitates the voice wake functionality outside of the app's main settings view, including configuration, error handling, and integration with system permissions.

classes.name: VoiceWakeRuntime
classes.description: An actor managing voice wake recognition, audio input, recognition sessions, and UI overlay coordination for voice-triggered commands outside the main settings view.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Asynchronously updates the runtime state based on the application state, starting or stopping recognition as needed.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the speech recognition session with a given configuration.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Terminates active recognition sessions and resets internal state.

methods.name: configureSession
methods.description: Configures the speech recognizer with the specified locale.

methods.name: handleRecognition
methods.description: Handles recognition results updates, manages capturing logic, and triggers command processing.

methods.name: maybeLogRecognition
methods.description: Logs recognition transcripts and segments for debugging, based on verbosity settings.

methods.name: noteAudioTap
methods.description: Logs audio tap RMS levels and updates UI overlay levels.

methods.name: noteRecognitionCallback
methods.description: Logs empty recognition callbacks for debugging purposes.

methods.name: scheduleTriggerOnlyPauseCheck
methods.description: Schedules a check for trigger-only pause detection after a delay.

methods.name: schedulePreDetectSilenceCheck
methods.description: Schedules a check for silence detection before pre-detection triggers.

methods.name: triggerOnlyPauseCheck
methods.description: Checks if trigger-only mode should activate capture based on recent transcript state.

methods.name: isTriggerOnly
methods.description: Determines if the current transcript is solely a trigger phrase.

methods.name: preDetectSilenceCheck
methods.description: Checks if fallback recognition should activate based on silence after no detection.

methods.name: beginCapture
methods.description: Initiates audio capture and recognition for a command after trigger detection.

methods.name: monitorCapture
methods.description: Monitors the ongoing capture, and finalizes it after timeout or silence.

methods.name: finalizeCapture
methods.description: Ends the current capture session, processes the command, and resets recognition state.

methods.name: noteAudioLevel
methods.description: Updates the adaptive noise floor and UI overlay levels based on audio RMS.

methods.name: rmsLevel
methods.description: Calculates RMS level from an audio buffer.

methods.name: restartRecognizer
methods.description: Restarts the speech recognizer with the current config.

methods.name: restartRecognizerIfIdleAndOverlayHidden
methods.description: Conditionally restarts recognition if not capturing and overlay is hidden.

methods.name: scheduleRestartRecognizer
methods.description: Schedules a recognizer restart after a specified delay.

methods.name: consumeScheduledRestart
methods.description: Clears scheduled restart task.

methods.name: applyPushToTalkCooldown
methods.description: Applies a cooldown period to prevent immediate retriggering.

methods.name: pauseForPushToTalk
methods.description: Sets state to push-to-talk mode and stops recognition.

methods.name: updateHeardBeyondTrigger
methods.description: Marks that speech was heard beyond the trigger word.

methods.name: trimmedAfterTrigger
methods.description: Static method to trim the command after the trigger phrase.

methods.name: commandAfterTrigger
methods.description: Returns command text after trigger, or full if none.
